caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top. The lantern is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a monochromatic color scheme typical of pencil or charcoal on paper. The cylindrical body is vertically oriented, and the front of the lantern features a door that is slightly ajar, allowing a view into the hollow interior. At the top of the lantern, there is a loop handle and a pattern of small perforations on the conical surface. The lantern also has a large, rounded side handle attached to the rear of the body. The composition places the lantern against a plain, light background with no additional objects or details.
title: Lantern
